content.text:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I’m excited to apply for the Senior Frontend Engineer role. My background is centered on React, TypeScript, design systems, and product-facing web applications, and I’m drawn to the opportunity to help lead frontend development for a customer-facing SaaS platform.

At BrightLayer, I led a design system migration used across four product squads, which gave me hands-on experience creating reusable UI patterns that support consistency and speed across teams. I also reduced page load time by 28 percent through bundle and rendering optimizations, and I enjoy the kind of performance work that makes a product feel noticeably better for customers.

Previously, as a Product Engineer at Northline Labs, I built experimentation dashboards for product and growth teams and partnered directly with design on customer-facing workflow improvements. That collaboration shaped how I approach frontend engineering: balancing technical quality with usability, iteration, and clear communication across product, design, and engineering.

I would bring a practical, product-minded frontend perspective to your team, along with experience in React, TypeScript, design systems, performance optimization, and A/B testing. I’d be glad to contribute to reusable UI systems, thoughtful experimentation, and a healthy engineering culture where junior engineers can grow.

Sincerely,  
Alex Martin
